info.name: Warehouse API
info.description: Auto-generated from the Doctrine/API Platform entities in src/Entity (see СХЕМА-БД.md). Run "Register user" then "Login" first — every other request inherits the collection's Bearer token from {{accessToken}}. Requests are ordered so that running each folder's "Create" request top to bottom fills in the id variables the later folders depend on (categoryId -> productId -> clientId/supplierId -> receiptId -> batchId -> ...).

request.description: Creates the account used by every other request in this collection.
Stores accessToken/refreshToken as collection variables. The collection's Bearer auth reads {{accessToken}} automatically.
GET collection of Categories.
Creates a new Categories record and stores its id in {{categoryId}}.
rate_date is the primary key, so nothing needs to be captured from the response.
GET collection of Products.
Creates a new Products record and stores its id in {{productId}}.
GET collection of Clients.
Creates a new Clients record and stores its id in {{clientId}}.
GET collection of Suppliers.
Creates a new Suppliers record and stores its id in {{supplierId}}.
